title: The Emerald Inheritance
description: A family drama of ambition, secrets, fashion and unexpected choices.

blocks.text: The grand doors opened, revealing a hall illuminated by crystal chandeliers. Conversations softened as the guests turned toward the entrance.

blocks.title: Every eye turns
blocks.text: For one suspended moment, the entire room seemed to hold its breath.
Lexis stepped forward. Her emerald dress caught the light, but she kept her attention on the faces waiting across the hall.

blocks.title: An unexpected greeting
blocks.text: You finally decided to show up.

blocks.title: How will Lexis respond?
blocks.text: The room waits to see what she will do.
Whatever happened next, Lexis knew that tonight would not be forgotten.
Behind the music and polished smiles, quiet conversations were beginning to reveal a different story.
